name: Growcord
note: THE one theme for every Growcord UI: the 14 suite panels, the store admin and the
platform console. This JSON is the data of record; suite/packages/kit/src/theme.css is
GENERATED from it by `node tools/theme/sync.mjs --build` and the copies in admin/ and
super-admin/ are mirrored by `node tools/theme/sync.mjs`. Nothing is hand-kept in step:
Tokens are named by ROLE, never by colour. A ramp (n/b/g/w/d/i) is raw material; a role
token is an alias into a ramp, so recolouring a store means changing a ramp, not hunting
for every place a shade was used.
Dark mode: every ramp's dark column is its light column REVERSED (50<->950). One rule,
no second set of values: --good-bg (g-50) becomes the darkest tint, --good (g-600)
becomes a bright green, --ink (n-900) becomes near-white. Tokens that are not ramp

ramps.label: Neutral
ramps.role: Warm stone grey — sits beside the orange without a green or blue cast. Canvas, ink, lines, table stripes. Tailwind gray/slate/zinc/neutral/stone.

ramps.label: Brand
ramps.role: Growcord orange (growcord.in’s orange-600). The one accent: primary buttons, active nav, links, focus. Tailwind indigo/violet/purple/fuchsia/pink map here.

ramps.label: Good
ramps.role: Success, in stock, paid, delivered. A fresher green than the brand so status never reads as chrome. Tailwind green/emerald/lime/teal.

ramps.label: Warn
ramps.role: Needs attention, pending, expiring, low stock. GOLD, not orange — the brand is orange, so a warning must be a different hue. Tailwind amber/yellow map here.

ramps.label: Bad
ramps.role: Failed, cancelled, out of stock, destructive actions. Tailwind red/rose.

ramps.label: Info
ramps.role: Neutral notice, links inside prose, 'here is how this works'. Tailwind blue/sky/cyan.

groups.name: Products
groups.note: One colour per Growcord platform (owner, 2026-09-27), each chosen to sit well beside the orange brand: blue and teal (its complements), violet and rose (its triad), amber (its warm sibling), green for WhatsApp. A panel sets `--accent` to its own product token on its root and derives hover/soft from it; the hub’s cards and the admin’s product tabs read the same names.

groups.name: Data visualisation
groups.note: Eight categorical series, assigned by entity in this fixed order — never cycled or re-ranked by value. Colour-vision-deficiency safe in sequence. Same in both themes: a chart's series must not change identity when the lights go out.

tokens.name: --space-1
tokens.role: 4px — hairline gap, icon to label. In rem, so the scale follows the browser text size like Tailwind's own.

tokens.name: --content-pad
tokens.role: The shell's content padding, every panel and the admin (owner, Prompt 9). One token; pages never pin a width or cancel it.

tokens.name: --content-pad-phone
tokens.role: The same pad on a phone face: 2% of 390px is 8px, under the platform's phone gutter, so it has a floor (plan gate G10).

tokens.name: --radius-md
tokens.role: Button, input, select — the one control radius.

tokens.name: --shadow-1
tokens.role: A card resting on the page.

tokens.name: --shadow-2
tokens.role: A popover or menu above the page.

tokens.name: --shadow-3
tokens.role: A dialog or drawer over everything.

tokens.name: --font
tokens.value: Inter, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Noto Sans", Arial, sans-serif

tokens.name: --mono
tokens.value: ui-monospace, "Cascadia Mono", Consolas, "Noto Sans Mono", monospace
tokens.role: SKU, id, code, anything meant to be compared character by character.

tokens.name: --text-sm
tokens.role: 14px — the workhorse size: table cell, field, button.

groups.name: Motion

tokens.name: --ease
tokens.role: The one easing: a gentle glide out.

tokens.name: --ease-in-out
tokens.role: For things that leave and come back (a collapsing panel).

tokens.name: --dur-quick
tokens.role: A colour or opacity change under the pointer.

tokens.name: --dur
tokens.role: A panel opening, a row expanding, a page settling.

tokens.name: --dur-slow
tokens.role: A dialog, a drawer, a page transition.

tokens.name: --dur-spin
tokens.role: A spinner’s turn; a pulse is twice this.

groups.note: Slow and soothing (owner, 2026-09-27): nothing snaps. Every transition and animation in every Growcord UI reads these; a page never states a millisecond of its own.

groups.name: Layering
groups.note: The kit's existing scale, unchanged: a toast has to be readable over a dialog, so it sits above it.

groups.name: Compatibility aliases
groups.note: The names the three code bases already use. They point at the tokens above so no panel or page breaks, and so there is exactly one place to learn every name. New code uses the role names above.

tokens.name: --shadow
tokens.role: kit — the one shadow it had.
